scenario_prompt: 14-day Japan trip with a strict budget of ₹1,80,000. Daily allowance limit ¥3,500 (covering food, entrance fees, and local transit).
itinerary_content: Day 1-14 Itinerary: Pre-paid accommodation ₹80,000. Flight ₹60,000. Daily food ¥2,000/day x 14 = ¥28,000 (₹16,000). Local transit and Keisei airport express ¥1,000/day x 14 = ¥14,000 (₹8,000). Daily total allowance spend is ¥3,000/day (¥2,000 food + ¥1,000 transit), which is strictly under the ¥3,500/day allowance limit. Total trip spend: ₹1,64,000 (under ₹1,80,000 limit).
description: Clean budget itinerary with fully itemized costs strictly under overall and daily limits.

scenario_prompt: Mid-trip replanning on Day 12. Must save ₹20,000 to offset emergency cost. Kyoto hostel (Days 15-18) and Narita flight (Day 28) are non-refundable and locked.
itinerary_content: Day 13-28 Replanning itemized savings breakdown: 1. Swapping Shinkansen bullet train (¥14,000) to Willer Express highway bus (¥5,500) saves ¥8,500 (₹5,100). 2. Swapping restaurant dinners (¥2,000) to konbini meals (¥600) over 10 days saves ¥14,000 (₹8,400). 3. Skipping paid castle interior (¥1,000) to view free gardens over 3 stops saves ¥3,000 (₹1,800). 4. Taking Keisei Main Line (¥1,050) instead of Skyliner (¥2,570) on departure saves ¥1,520 (₹900). Total verified savings: ¥27,020 (₹16,200) + ₹3,800 activity cuts = ₹20,000 exact target savings. Locked bookings preserved: Days 15-18 Kyoto hostel kept. Day 28 Narita departure flight kept.
description: Clean mid-trip replanning itinerary with explicit itemized pricing math matching target savings with locked anchors preserved.

scenario_prompt: Must save ₹20,000 by making budget travel swaps.
itinerary_content: Day 13-28 Replanning: Taking local highway bus instead of bullet train saves ₹20,000. (Actual bus ticket cost is ¥6,000 vs bullet train ¥13,000, which only saves ~¥7,000/₹4,000).
description: Claims ₹20,000 savings from a single bus swap without mathematical foundation.

scenario_prompt: Reduce total trip cost by ₹15,000.
itinerary_content: Day 1-10: By eating at local convenience stores, we save ₹15,000 overall. (No daily breakdown or itemized price list provided).
description: Vague unquantified savings claim without pricing math.

scenario_prompt: Keep total spend under ₹1,50,000.
itinerary_content: Total expenses: Flight ₹50,000 + Hotels ₹60,000 + Food ₹30,000 + Transit ₹20,000 = Total ₹1,40,000. (Actual sum is 50k+60k+30k+20k = ₹1,60,000, which exceeds ₹1,50,000 limit).
description: Addition math error in total expense summary.

scenario_prompt: Cut accommodation budget by 30%.
itinerary_content: Swapping 5 nights from ¥10,000/night hotel to ¥8,000/night hostel saves ¥25,000. (5 x ¥2,000 savings is ¥10,000, not ¥25,000).
description: Multiplication error in accommodation savings claim.

scenario_prompt: Recover ₹10,000 budget deficit.
itinerary_content: We recovered the ₹10,000 by choosing cheaper walking tours and free museum days. (No financial math provided).
description: Unsubstantiated narrative assertion of budget recovery.
